requirements.text: Actor is a class that describes actors. Actors are able to fulfill some goals using resources thanks to a plan.
Goal is a class.
SoftGoal is a class that describes those particular goals that are said to be soft.
The ActorConcept has a HardGoal.
Dependency is a class that represent dependencies.
An actor concept model contains plans
An actor model contains resources
An actor may have some dependencies.
An actor can have zero or several goals.
An actor may use some resources.
A goal is wanted by one actor, that is called its wanter.
A goal may have some dependencies. What "WG" means is unclear, it could mean "With Goal".
An actor concept model contains dependencies and actors. Each dependency is associated to exactly one actor
In an actor concept model, there are dependencies and goals. Each dependency is associate to none or one goal
In an actor concept model, each dependency is associated to one resource at the most to explain why
In an actor concept model, each dependency is associated to one plan at the most to explain why
In an actor concept model, each plan is fufilled by one goal
In an actor concept model, plans may have dependencies
In an actor concept model, each resource uses exactly one actor
In an actor concept model, each resource is associated to exacly one dependency
